baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ points to a contemplated return and predicates loss of it as an inferred consequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers externalize a verdict: ك ر ر supplies return or repetition after departure, while خ س ر supplies diminution and forfeited capital. The return itself is therefore priced as a loss-bearing recurrence.

activation_trace.role: Utterance brought out in speech makes the loss verdict a publicly stated assessment.
Return and renewed repetition after departure supply the event being evaluated.
Commercial loss supplies the speakers' value calculus for the contemplated return.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely calls an unspecified future event bad.
changed_reading.after: The speakers calculate the contemplated return itself as a recurrence that forfeits value.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَرَّةٌ can name not only recurrence but a renewed charge after retreat, and خَاسِرَةٌ marks its adverse result.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return is pictured tactically as a counterturn or second charge. Calling it خاسرة places the speakers on the side that expects to lose when the direction of movement reverses.

activation_trace.role: The branch's renewed attack after flight turns recurrence into a tactical reversal.
General diminution gives the renewed charge an adverse outcome for its speakers.

changed_reading.before: كَرَّةٌ is a neutral second occurrence.
changed_reading.after: كَرَّةٌ is a feared counterturn whose renewed movement makes the speakers the losing side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ permits the material branches of a kurr measure and a short measure to interact.
baseline_models.mechanism: A kurr is a large unit of measure, while إخسار is giving short weight or measure. The speakers' inferential statement can thus carry a material image of a supposedly large yield that comes up deficient.

activation_trace.role: Speech operating like conjecture frames the deficient-yield image as the speakers' calculation.
The large kurr measure supplies a quantity expected to be full or abundant.
Shorting a scale or measure makes the expected quantity come up deficient.

changed_reading.after: The return is imagined as a measured yield that fails to deliver its expected quantity or value.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attraction back to an origin, explicit restoration to a prior place, and return to the beginning converge on كَرَّةٌ. The feared event is no longer generic repetition but restoration from the condition named immediately before the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure anchors the restored-to-origin reading in كَرَّةٌ.
Diminution supplies the speakers' adverse verdict on being restored.
Attraction of a thing back to its origin supplies an origin-directed vector for the return.
Restoring a thing to its place identifies the contemplated motion as reinstatement.
Return to the first state gives the reinstatement a beginning-point rather than a mere second occurrence.

structural_cues: 79:10 places مَرْدُودُونَ beside ٱلْحَافِرَةِ, and 79:11 names the decayed-bone condition from which return is contemplated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three origin-and-return images; I infer that they converge on restoration of a prior embodied state. A live alternative is that ٱلْحَافِرَةِ contributes only an idiomatic beginning-point without a material-restoration image.

changed_reading.before: The speakers object to an abstract repetition.
changed_reading.after: They call restoration to an original state, even from decay, the very return that would make them lose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding bodies shake, hearts flutter, and eyes sink. Against that sequence, the repeated throat-sound branch of ك ر ر makes the quoted sentence readable as a reverberating or constricted bodily utterance, not only a detached proposition.

activation_trace.role: Voiced articulation anchors the model in the speakers' actual saying.
A sound reiterated in the throat supplies bodily reverberation inside the word for return.
Diminution lets the vocalized verdict register the speakers' own collapse in composure.
Severe shaking supplies the first bodily oscillation around the utterance.
Fluttering and heart-pounding internalize the oscillation in the speakers.
Sinking submission gives the agitation a visible downward bodily result.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from cosmic trembling in 79:6 to fluttering hearts in 79:8 and lowered eyes in 79:9 immediately before the exchange in 79:10-12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily oscillation and a throat-repetition branch; I infer that the utterance can embody the fear it voices. The live alternative is ordinary propositional speech with no physiological coloring.

changed_reading.before: The sentence is a composed intellectual verdict about return.
changed_reading.after: The verdict reverberates through destabilized speakers, so their declaration of loss also betrays their own bodily undoing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers imagine a costly renewed process, but the adjacent response supplies a voiced rebuke occurring once. Their كَرَّة is rhetorically compressed from an onerous repetition into the result of one decisive impulse.

activation_trace.role: Their articulated verdict sets one voice-event against the answering voice-event.
Renewed repetition supplies the supposedly burdensome process that is compressed.
A forceful vocal rebuke supplies the efficient impulse that effects the transition.
Numerical oneness constrains the effecting impulse to a single occurrence.

structural_cues: 79:13 directly follows the loss verdict with a restrictive singular construction, and 79:14 marks immediate arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed return, vocal rebuke, and numerical oneness; I infer a rhetorical contrast between imagined costly process and actual single cause. Alternatively, وَاحِدَةٌ may qualify only the rebuke without commenting on the speakers' process model.

changed_reading.before: The return is a costly second cycle.
changed_reading.after: The supposedly costly cycle requires only one decisive summons, exposing the speakers' estimate as inflated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural saying is activated as circulating public doctrine. Gathering, loud calling, arrogant elevation, and exemplary punishment in the later speech scene turn the focus verdict into a self-protective slogan whose public assertion also makes it self-incriminating.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people makes the plural verdict a repeatable public slogan.
Speech as belief or doctrine gives the slogan a committed worldview rather than a passing exclamation.
Commercial loss supplies the slogan's appeal to collective self-interest.
A raised public call supplies the broadcast mode of the later proclamation.
Gathering a group toward one purpose supplies the social audience that turns speech into collective doctrine.
Arrogant elevation identifies the power posture embodied by the public claim.
Punishment that deters others turns proclaimed doctrine into a publicly legible self-indictment.

structural_cues: The surah sets several speech scenes in sequence: the collective exchange at 79:10-12, the invitation at 79:18, and the gathered proclamation at 79:23-24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural speech, gathering, broadcast, elevation, and deterrent outcome; I infer a narrative analogy in which public claims disclose the claimant's losing posture. The alternative is that the two speech scenes are independent and the focus saying remains private banter.

changed_reading.before: A group spontaneously comments that return would be disadvantageous.
changed_reading.after: The group circulates a loss-centered doctrine that protects present power while publicly locating its speakers on the losing side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deficient-measure baseline meets a sequence of estimation, joined construction, completed form, and stabilization. The context converts خَاسِرَةٌ from an objective defect in the return into the speakers' own faulty measurement of reconstructive capacity.

activation_trace.role: The kurr as a large measure anchors the speakers' quantitative image of the return.
Short measure supplies the alleged deficiency that the construction sequence rebuts.
Estimating and measuring a thing supplies calibrated design rather than short measure.
Building by joining parts supplies competent recomposition.
Straightness and completion supply a finished form with no missing quantity.
Firm stabilization supplies durable completion to the reconstruction model.

structural_cues: 79:27-32 proceeds through comparative creation, building, raising, completing, bringing forth, and anchoring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, assembly, completion, and stability; I infer that this material sequence answers the focus clause's alleged deficient yield. The alternative is to keep the kurr-measure branch as wordplay with no argumentative force.

changed_reading.before: The return is a measured reconstruction expected to come up short.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding construction sequence exposes the shortfall as a defect in the speakers' estimate, not in the reconstructed return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Work and acquisition are later exposed alongside deliberate preference for the nearer life. This makes خَاسِرَةٌ speaker-indexed: return looks loss-making because it audits the portfolio the speakers chose to accumulate, not because return is intrinsically deficient.

activation_trace.role: Speech as an adopted belief makes the verdict disclose the speakers' value system.
Return after departure supplies the moment when the earlier investment is revisited.
Loss of capital supplies the audit metaphor governing the speakers' evaluation.
Work, earning, and conduct supply the accumulated activity subject to the return's audit.
Deliberate preference identifies the valuation choice behind calling the return a loss.
The nearer or lower world identifies the asset class the speakers privilege.

structural_cues: 79:35 makes prior striving recallable, while 79:37-41 sorts outcomes by transgression, preference, fear, and restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earning, preference, and the nearer life; I infer an audit in which return realizes the consequences of prior valuation. The alternative is that خَاسِرَةٌ names objective destruction without revealing a speaker-specific investment.

changed_reading.before: Return is objectively a losing event for anyone.
changed_reading.after: Return becomes loss only relative to a life invested in the nearer order, so the verdict inadvertently confesses the speakers' chosen valuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mooring, endpoint, and the collapse of apparent duration prevent كَرَّةٌ from becoming an endless loop. The counter-movement settles at a terminal destination, so its feared loss is irreversibility rather than the cost of repeated cycling.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure supplies the counter-movement whose endpoint must be determined.
Irrecoverable diminution supplies the consequence of terminal settlement.
A vessel's stopping and mooring give the return a fixed arrival rather than another pass in a loop.
The limit at which a thing ends makes the moored arrival terminal.
Delay and slowness, explicitly negated in the scene, collapse the duration the speakers might price as costly.

structural_cues: 79:42 asks when the event will be moored, 79:44 assigns its endpoint, and 79:46 reduces the perceived prior stay to an evening or morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopping, endpoint, and curtailed delay; I infer that they convert recurrence into a one-way terminal return. A live alternative is that the mooring language concerns timing alone and leaves كَرَّةٌ as ordinary repetition.

changed_reading.before: كَرَّةٌ is another costly turn in an open sequence.
changed_reading.after: كَرَّةٌ is the final counterturn that moors the sequence at its endpoint, making loss irreversible rather than repetitive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates rope, knot, and twisting branches rather than the ordinary return sense. It remains anchored because ك ر ر explicitly supplies a thick cord of gathered strands while the context supplies tying, untangling, and twisting; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for recomposition, not replace the lexical sense of كَرَّةٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَرَّةٌ carries a thick twisted-cord branch, and خَاسِرَةٌ can mark diminution in what is recomposed.

activation_trace.role: A thick cord made from gathered, twisted strengths supplies the material model of recomposition.
General diminution supplies the speakers' fear that recomposition will return less than was separated.
A looped knot being tied or released supplies separation and reversibility of strands.
Twisting supplies the operation that regathers separated strengths into one cord.

changed_reading.before: Return is the recurrence of an already whole entity.
changed_reading.after: Return is exploratory reassembly: separated strands are twisted back together, which the speakers predict will yield a diminished whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it activates the pool-water branch of ك ر ر against an eschatological utterance. It remains valid as a packet-grounded analogy: gathered water emerges into pasture and benefit, directly reversing the commercial-loss branch of خ س ر; downstream prose should present it as an ecological counterimage, not as the noun's primary denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَرَّةٌ has a gathered-water branch and خَاسِرَةٌ has a failed-trade branch, allowing a productive-cycle counterimage.

activation_trace.role: Water gathered in a pool supplies stored material that can re-enter a productive sequence.
Failed trade supplies the loss verdict that the productive water sequence reverses.
Bringing a hidden thing out supplies emergence from storage into use.
Water's appearance and increase turn gathered material into renewed abundance.
Pasture supplies the concrete yield of the emerging water.
Enjoyed benefit converts the material cycle into gain rather than failed trade.

changed_reading.before: Any return consumes value and therefore loses.
changed_reading.after: A return can resemble gathered water re-emerging as pasture and benefit, making renewed circulation productive rather than loss-making.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping of the focus speech root. It remains anchored by the packet's explicit split mapping and by nearby shaking and heart-flutter cues; downstream prose must call it a form-distant secondary activation, not a morphological replacement for قَالُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus ق و ل secondarily to ق ل ل branches of belittling and instability, while the explicit predicate names loss.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and belittling make the utterance itself an attempt to minimize the return.
Instability and motion make that minimizing speech betray agitation.
Diminution is both what the speakers assert and what their unstable posture enacts.
Severe shaking activates the split mapping's instability image.
Heart-flutter locates the instability inside the speakers who belittle the return.

changed_reading.before: They neutrally report an estimate of future loss.
changed_reading.after: Their saying performs belittlement of the return while its instability betrays the fear that the belittling tries to master.

strongest_changes: Return sharpened from generic recurrence into restoration to an origin from the immediately named condition of decay.
The adjacent single rebuke compressed the speakers' supposedly costly repeated process into one decisive impulse.
The commercial loss verdict became speaker-indexed: return audits a prior preference for the nearer life.
Measured construction and completion relocated deficiency from the return to the speakers' own estimate.
Final mooring and endpoint cues changed recurrence into an irreversible terminal counterturn.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package repeatedly changed who or what bears the loss. Focus-only reading assigns loss to the return; origin, speech, construction, preference, and endpoint cues instead expose restoration, public stance, faulty measurement, prior investment, and irreversibility as distinct mechanisms. Material branches also preserved rope-reassembly and productive-water counterimages that a conservative synthesis would likely omit.
remaining_uncertainties: The tactical countercharge remains available inside ك ر ر B001 but is not uniquely selected by the syntax.
The kurr-measure, rope, water, throat-sound, and ق ل ل activations are branch-grounded but form- or domain-distant and must remain exploratory.
The public-slogan reading depends on a narrative analogy between separate speech scenes rather than an explicit grammatical linkage.
Mooring may orient only the timing of the event rather than convert كَرَّةٌ itself into terminal settlement.
